summary: Iteration 53 tested Procurement Module 4, the Anti-Fraud Engine and the 7 Core Member boards. Backend: 7 of 7 pytest tests passed (test_iter53_procurement_fraud.py). They covered PO→GRN rules, the 3-way invoice match and double billing, bill-locks dates, the stock reconcile → fraud block → indent/requisition 423 → GM release flow, auto-clear, chunked files and cron 401. Frontend: the Core Dashboard shows only the Dashboard and Core Setup buttons and all 7 member tabs. Each tab shows the spec KPI cards, grids and form buttons. The modal forms work: a Stock Register save gave RED ALERT and an HR Ticket saved. The fraud panel's Reconcile and Release work. The Financial link buttons navigate correctly. RFQ/CS works: L1 is auto-green, save → submit → approve → Generate PO created a Draft PO for the L1 vendor. The GRN tab has the GRN and stock register forms, and the billing tab has the three-way register. The new Vendor fields and the doc-slot gating work, and real 25MB chunk uploads go through the UI. The BOQ budget gate and the WO GST/retention UI render. With 3-way entry missing, a new bill submit shows the ANTI-FRAUD BLOCK toast. I found and fixed one CRITICAL bug: a missing await in VendorRegistration submit/approve. Two medium frontend bugs remain (see action items).

minor.issue: Has no ACL. Any logged-in user can download any uploaded file (vendor PAN/GST/cheque docs) if they know the fileId.
Any logged-in role can list all fraud blocks. Consider restricting it to the _fraud_ops roles.

The declared size is not checked against the bytes actually received, so the client-declared size is trusted for the 25MB limit. Each chunk is limited to 1.5MB of base64, but 'total' is unbounded, and file_get only reads to_list(100) chunks.

The cumulative check only counts acceptedQty (QC Pass). receivedQty on Fail/Under-Lab-Test GRNs is unbounded versus PO qty. A GRN saved as 'Under Lab Test' and later edited to Pass is re-checked, which is OK.
The fraud-block 423 also applies to GM/SuperAdmin, unlike indents where GM/SA bypass. Confirm this is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. advanceVendorStep (store.js:919) is async, but both handlers used it without await. setVendor(Promise) blanked the form (Step 1, temp placeholder). Approve then said 'Please Submit for Checking first', and when it did run it spread a Promise ({...Promise} = {}), which upserted a junk vendor holding only {history}. This blocked approving any vendor from the UI. I added async/await to both handlers.

calc-tds-rate is not recalculated when a vendor is fetched. For PAN ABCPK1234L (4th char P) it still shows '2% · Firm / Company'. It only switches to 1% on the first Submit, which aborts with the toast 'TDS vendor type ke hisaab se auto-set hua — dobara Submit karein', so the user has to submit twice. Fix: in fetchVendor call setBill({...bill, vendorCode, vendorSnapshot: v, tdsRate: tdsFor(v)}).

After saving a Stock Register entry in the core modal (which creates a RED ALERT block), the FraudPanel list is not reloaded on modal close. The new block only appears after Reconcile Now or a page reload.

Uses `if (!saved) handleSave();` without checking the result. In the UI the 'Add at least one line item' toast fired, yet submit carried on to the gate. For a Client Master BOQ the gate passes, so an invalid or empty BOQ could be advanced to step 2. This is inferred from the code; I did not persist it to avoid polluting data.

issues: The 6th tab 'Store & GRN' wraps onto its own full-width row under the other 5 tab cards. Use a 6-column grid or make the cards smaller.
The GST % select and Unit columns are too narrow: the select shows blank and the item description is truncated. GST options show '0' instead of 'Exempted', unlike the WO GST options.
The subtitle still lists only 4 members (Civil, OHE, Electrical, Procurement). It should mention all 7.

critical_code_review_comments: RfqCs.genPO uses the PO id `po_${Date.now()}_${j}`. Repeated clicks create duplicate POs with no idempotency, and two items with the same L1 vendor in the same millisecond would overwrite each other. Use `po_${cs.id}_${i}` and skip if it exists.
RfqCs: the CS-level l1Vendor is chosen by lowest total, while POs are generated per item by item-level L1. This is inconsistent when vendors differ per item.

BillProcessing.handleSubmit at step 3 with net >30L calls routeToDiscussion BEFORE the unverified-items and required-name checks, and mutates bill.discussionReqId directly. If a later check fails, the state is not persisted, and each retry or reload creates another Finance requisition.
Reports.threeWayLocks falls back to b.billDate when createdAt is missing. A back-dated billDate on a new bill would skip the 3-way rule. Always rely on server/creation timestamps.
cs-approve testid ends in 'approve', so the global App.css hide rule (body.ae-no-approve) hides it for non-approver roles. This is fine if intended, but the CSS rule is fragile (see iteration_52).
PurchaseManagement.jsx (1288 lines) and BillProcessing.jsx (1974 lines) are far over the 700-line limit. Split them by tab or step.
server.py has 3056 lines. Move the anti-fraud, files and requisitions code into routers.
action_items: Review and keep the testing-agent fix in VendorRegistration.jsx: handleSubmit and handleApprove are now async and await advanceVendorStep.
MEDIUM: set tdsRate from tdsFor(v) in BillProcessing fetchVendor so the read-only TDS shows 1% for PAN 4th char P/H immediately and no double submit is needed.
MEDIUM: BOQ (and WO) handleSubmit must abort when handleSave validation fails.
MEDIUM: make RfqCs Generate PO idempotent with a deterministic PO id per CS item.
MEDIUM: in BillProcessing step 3 >30L, run all validations before routeToDiscussion and persist discussionReqId immediately with upsertBill.
LOW: reload FraudPanel after a core modal closes, add an ACL to GET /api/files/{id}, widen the CS matrix GST/Unit columns, update the core hero subtitle, and fix the purchase tab wrapping.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core boards, fraud panel, RFQ/CS, GRN, three-way register, vendor gating, BOQ gate, WO GST/retention and the anti-fraud bill block all work. Vendor approval was broken until fixed. The TDS display bug remains)

rca of the issue: Vendor approval broken: store.advanceVendorStep became async (commit 96d7dd9, server-first vendor serial), but VendorRegistration still called it synchronously. setVendor got a Promise, so the form fields went blank and step became undefined, which displays as Step 1. Approve spread the Promise into {} and upserted a junk record. Repro: New Vendor → fill → Save → fill Checked By, Category, 3 docs → Submit → the status shows Step 1 again → Final Approval says 'Please Submit for Checking first'. Mitigation applied: await in both handlers.
